explication: Notepad++ is a Windows source-code and text editor. The principal workflow is: a user opens or edits a document, the application coordinates the editor and document buffer, language services provide syntax styling and searches, and file/encoding services persist the result. The tree also shows plugins, dockable panels, projects, function lists, dark mode, and DPI-aware UI. Some relationships are inferred from explicit module responsibilities; unsampled implementations are represented conservatively.
